title: Length of a single block
statement: For a configuration $c$ of a machine with $k$ work tapes, any integer coordinate $j$, and either value of the read flag, the block encoding coordinate $j$ has length $k$.
replaced:
Every block encoding a single coordinate of a configuration of a $k$-work-tape machine
is a list of length $k$, in both its unread and read-marked forms.
